data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.description: Advanced discourse markers and inversion structures
learningPoints: Strengthens advanced discourse markers and logical cohesion.
Develops inversion structures for rhetorical emphasis.
Improves contrast and argument balance in formal writing.
Builds precision in academic comparison and evaluation.
Enhances persuasive and analytical writing skills.

sections.summary: Use 'Not only... but also' with inversion.
sections.explain: When 'Not only' begins a sentence, inversion is required.

words.word: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved efficiency.
Not only the policy reduced costs, but it also improved efficiency.
Not only did the policy reduce costs, but also it improved efficiency.

sections.explain: After negative adverbs like 'Rarely', auxiliary inversion is required.

words.word: Rarely have researchers encountered such clear evidence.
Rarely researchers have encountered such clear evidence.
Rarely did researchers have encountered such clear evidence.

sections.explain: 'Whereas' connects two contrasting clauses in formal comparison.

words.word: Urban areas expanded rapidly, whereas rural populations declined.
Urban areas expanded rapidly whereas but rural populations declined.
Whereas urban areas expanded rapidly, rural populations.

sections.explain: 'Nevertheless' contrasts with the previous statement and requires correct punctuation.

words.word: The proposal was risky. Nevertheless, it was approved.
The proposal was risky nevertheless it was approved.
Nevertheless the proposal was risky, it was approved.

sections.explain: Negative expressions at the beginning require inversion.

words.word: On no account should confidential data be shared.
On no account confidential data should be shared.
On no account should be shared confidential data.
Sales increased in Europe. In contrast, they declined in Asia.
Sales increased in Europe in contrast they declined in Asia.
In contrast sales increased in Europe they declined in Asia.

sections.explain: 'Hardly' at the beginning requires inversion and is followed by 'when'.

words.word: Hardly had the meeting begun when the alarm sounded.
Hardly the meeting had begun when the alarm sounded.
Hardly had the meeting begun than the alarm sounded.

sections.explain: 'No sooner' requires inversion and is followed by 'than'.

words.word: No sooner had the company launched the product than demand surged.
No sooner the company had launched the product than demand surged.
No sooner had the company launched the product when demand surged.

sections.explain: 'While' can introduce contrast between two clauses.

words.word: While some experts support the reform, others strongly oppose it.
While some experts support the reform but others strongly oppose it.
While support the reform some experts, others strongly oppose it.

sections.summary: Complex argument structure with contrast and result.
sections.explain: Advanced academic writing often combines contrast and consequence logically.

words.word: Although the initial results were promising, further analysis revealed significant limitations.
Although the initial results were promising but further analysis revealed significant limitations.
Although the initial results were promising, nevertheless further analysis revealed significant limitations.
